summary: If something moves you deeply, give yourself enough curiosity to understand why before you hand it your loyalty, money, or trust.
body: If something moves you deeply, give yourself enough curiosity to understand why before you hand it your loyalty, money, or trust. When Neptune sextiles Pluto, empathy and intuition can draw your attention toward the motive, history, hidden incentive, or power dynamic underneath the version of the story that first caught your heart. Learning more does not require you to become cynical about what matters to you. It gives you a chance to make sure your support is going toward the thing you actually believe in rather than the version that was easiest to sell.
